The fires' own credential, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` (the "coding-agent subscription token" of ruling 1), still authenticates through the fires' exact path (`claude auth status` under `~/.claude-fires` reads loggedIn; a one-word `-p` probe answered), so the value exposed on 2026-08-25 is STILL LIVE: the owner mints a new one (`claude setup-token`), pastes it as `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN=`, and revokes the old one in his account; the attended session re-probes and closes. The droplet holds no stray copy (`find / -name .env.local` empty, `/opt/goldrush/.env.local` absent, read-only over the deploy's own ssh path). The Codex login was refreshed today (`~/.codex/auth.json`, "Logged in using ChatGPT"). Retires when: both new values answer live to the same read-only calls, the Claude probe passes on a NEW value (`.env.local` rewritten) and the owner says the old one is revoked. The original finding is the F-2299-1 row of s2299 below. ➡️ **UPDATE 2026-09-24 18:15 local (owner: "I rotated all tokens in the .env.local file", "I rolled it again"):** the owner rotated all three at the providers and minted a new Claude Code token, but pasted twice into the sibling folder's copy (`Gold Rush-history-local/.env.local`, the pre-rewrite local history), which nothing reads; the attended session found it by mtime, verified its values read-only (Cloudflare `active`, ElevenLabs `200`, the new Claude token answers through the fires' path, per-line hashes: the three rotated lines DIFFERENT, the account id, the router key and the droplet host identical), backed the old root file up outside every git tree (`~/.goldrush/env.local.bak-2026-09-24`, mode 600; a `.bak` beside `.env.local` would NOT be gitignored) and copied the edited file into the repo root; re-verified from the root: Cloudflare `active`, ElevenLabs `200`, Claude `ok`, `wrangler whoami` logged in. Then I logged in again, logged in here, then did claude setup-token, copied it in .env.local and then told you done."):** MEASURED, not inferred: after that button, the August token (from the backup) and the 18:13 token (minted before the button) BOTH still answer through the fires' auth path; the button ends browser and CLI sessions (this CLI needed `/login`) but does not revoke long-lived `claude setup-token` tokens. The CLI cannot revoke either (`claude auth logout` clears local credentials only; the only revoke code in the binary is a bundled Google OAuth library; the account endpoints refuse the token with `permission_error`, so its e-mail cannot be read from the token; every login recorded on this Mac is `robin@brainstem.health`, and the fires' config dir dates from 2026-07-08, so the token was minted on or before that day). REMAINING, owner-side: an Anthropic support request to revoke the Claude Code token minted on or before 2026-07-08 for `robin@brainstem.health` (the exposed one; the 2026-09-24 tokens stay), or its natural expiry; the attended session re-probes from the backup and closes the row when it fails.
